verses.original: שִׁ֗יר לַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֶשָּׂ֣א עֵ֭ינַי אֶל־ הֶהָרִ֑ים מֵ֝אַ֗יִן יָבֹ֥א עֶזְרִֽי׃
verses.literal: A song of ascents I lift up my eyes to the hills From where does my help come
verses.literalPt: LEVANTAREI os meus olhos para os montes, de onde vem o meu socorro.

verses.original: עֶ֭זְרִי מֵעִ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.literal: My help comes from the LORD the Maker of heaven and earth
verses.literalPt: O meu socorro vem do SENHOR que fez o céu e a terra.

verses.original: אַל־ יִתֵּ֣ן לַמּ֣וֹט רַגְלֶ֑ךָ אַל־ יָ֝נ֗וּם שֹֽׁמְרֶֽךָ׃
verses.literal: He will not allow your foot to slip your Protector will not slumber
verses.literalPt: Não deixará vacilar o teu pé; aquele que te guarda não tosquenejará.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה לֹֽא־ יָ֭נוּם וְלֹ֣א יִישָׁ֑ן שׁוֹמֵ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh lō- yā·nūm wə·lō yî·šān šō·w·mêr yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Behold the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep
verses.literalPt: Eis que não tosquenejará nem dormirá o guarda de Israel.

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה שֹׁמְרֶ֑ךָ יְהוָ֥ה צִ֝לְּךָ֗ עַל־ יַ֥ד יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh šō·mə·re·ḵā Yah·weh ṣil·lə·ḵā ‘al- yaḏ yə·mî·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: The LORD is your keeper the LORD is the shade on your right hand
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR é quem te guarda; o SENHOR é a tua sombra à tua direita.

verses.original: יוֹמָ֗ם הַשֶּׁ֥מֶשׁ לֹֽא־ יַכֶּ֗כָּה וְיָרֵ֥חַ בַּלָּֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·mām haš·še·meš lō- yak·kek·kāh wə·yā·rê·aḥ bal·lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: The sun will not strike you by day nor the moon by night
verses.literalPt: O sol não te molestará de dia nem a lua de noite.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה יִשְׁמָרְךָ֥ מִכָּל־ רָ֑ע יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת־ נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yiš·mā·rə·ḵā mik·kāl rā‘ yiš·mōr ’eṯ- nap̄·še·ḵā
verses.literal: The LORD will guard you from all evil He will preserve your soul
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR te guardará de todo o mal; guardará a tua alma.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה יִשְׁמָר־ צֵאתְךָ֥ וּבוֹאֶ֑ךָ מֵֽ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yiš·mār- ṣê·ṯə·ḵā ū·ḇō·w·’e·ḵā mê·‘at·tāh wə·‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: The LORD will watch over your coming and going both now and forevermore . . .
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR guardará a tua entrada e a tua saída, desde agora e para sempre.
